logp.method_description: The logPo/w values of the Pt(IV) complexes were determined by the shake flask method.58 The respective Pt(IV) complex was dissolved in ultrapure water, presaturated with n-octanol, containing 0.9% NaCl (w/v). The solution was sonicated and undissolved Pt(IV) complex was removed. The Pt concentration was determined by ICP-MS. Then, the Pt(IV) solution was added to an equal volume of n-octanol, presaturated with 0.9% NaCl (w/v) in ultrapure water. After vigorous shaking for 30 min, the mixture was centrifuged at 4000 rpm for 30 min to achieve phase separation. The Pt concentration in the aqueous phase was analyzed by ICP-MS. The logPo/w value was calculated as the logarithm of the ratio of Pt concentrations in the organic and aqueous phases.
